messages.content:
Classify the extracted chapter tables or maintenance cards against the explicit conventions and source evidence. Evaluate meaning and attachment, not just structural validity. Use only supplied evidence. A fused header with correct paired values is format-only; wrong source values or attachments are semantic defects. Incomplete/ambiguous evidence without an established defect means uncertain. Return one class.
{"conformant": "The text and row ownership match source evidence and explicit document-local conventions; allowed layout variations are not defects.", "format_drift": "A documented table/header/layout convention is violated, but no row value, meaning or attachment contradicts source evidence.", "row_semantic_issue": "A row value, meaning or note attachment contradicts source evidence, while table/header/layout conventions are satisfied.", "mixed": "Both a table/header/layout convention violation and a source-supported row value, meaning or attachment defect are present.", "uncertain": "Evidence or explicit conventions are insufficient or ambiguous to establish whether this chapter is conformant or defective."}

{"conventions": {"required_fields": ["Installed", "Technician"], "layout": "One titled card per asset. Field order may vary. Each card has a local Notes list; a note labelled GLOBAL may instead appear in document_footer. Combining two asset titles in one card or duplicating the same asset into multiple cards is format drift.", "meaning": "Installed is installation year. Technician is current responsible person. Local Notes are work performed on that asset; GLOBAL advice applies to all assets."}, "source_evidence": "Pump A was installed in 2020. R. Fen is responsible for it; its seal was replaced. Valve B entered service in 2021 under L. Orin; its pressure was inspected. Global advice: isolate power before servicing.", "cards": [{"title": "Pump A", "fields": {"Installed": "2020", "Technician": "R. Fen"}, "notes": ["Pressure inspected"]}, {"title": "Valve B", "fields": {"Installed": "2021", "Technician": "L. Orin"}, "notes": ["Seal replaced"]}], "document_footer": []}
